metadata.description: Vaadin 25 development skills and MCP tools for Claude Code

plugins.name: vaadin-skills
plugins.description: Skills and tools for building high-quality Vaadin 25 applications with Java/Flow — theming, visual design, and form layout. Includes the hosted Vaadin MCP server for current documentation and API lookup.

plugins.name: vaadin-agent-tools
plugins.description: Experimental (early testing) — Vaadin tools for AI agents to bootstrap, inspect, and validate Vaadin projects. Ships a self-contained native CLI (no Node or JVM required at runtime); scaffolds new projects from start.vaadin.com and includes an Aura/Lumo theme-mixing checker.
